# I can't compute the embedded emissions yet

**I cannot compute a definitive embedded-emissions figure for this shipment.** The ruleset selects the SEE jointly by CN code and country of production, and the country has not been provided.

## Input check

| Required input | Status | Value |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | ✅ Provided | 7207 11 90 (semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel) |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | ❌ **Missing** | "One of our partner plants." Origin is to be confirmed by the mill's certificate, which isn't attached. |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ Provided | 4,200 t |

## Missing input

1. **Country of production** of the CN 7207 11 90 billets. It must be one of the countries listed for this CN code in the factor table (Türkiye, China or India) for a default SEE to apply.

## Why this matters

The default SEE for CN 7207 11 90 varies significantly by country in the table (3.087, 3.314 and 4.32 tCO2e/t). So the result depends entirely on the confirmed origin. Under the ruleset, I will not assume or estimate the country.

## Next step

Please send the mill's certificate or another confirmation of the country of production. Once I have it, the calculation is:

**Embedded emissions = SEE (CN 7207 11 90, confirmed country) × 4,200 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

If the confirmed country is not Türkiye, China or India, the table has no default value for it, and I still won't be able to compute the figure under this ruleset.
